inv.desc_en:
✨ Spacious, bright, and with multiple possibilities in the heart of Entrevías

Are you looking for a versatile space with great visibility and perfect for setting up your business? This space at Calle Hornachos 12 is a unique opportunity for entrepreneurs, investors, or professionals who need a well-connected space ready to adapt to any activity.
? Main features

Large area with a very usable distribution

Facade with a showcase that guarantees constant visibility

Street-level entrance

Great natural light

Ideal for hospitality, commerce, office, beauty center, academy, or warehouse

Possibility of adapting the space to your needs

Area with consolidated pedestrian and residential traffic
? Strategic location

Located on a quiet but busy street, surrounded by homes, shops, and services.

Very close to:

Public transport

Green areas

Schools and sports centers

Main access roads to the neighborhood

Perfect for attracting local and passing customers.
? Why is this space a great opportunity?

Competitive price in a growing area

Very versatile space

Ideal for both investment and own business

Environment with real demand for services
? Come see it

This space has a lot of potential and deserves to be visited.

Contact us for more information or to arrange a visit.
